method: CUDA graphs; random order; ~50ms warmup before each sample. All variants reuse the same output addresses. G=1. Unlocked clocks.

integration.scope: Pure MXFP8 forward: BF16 output, optional native FP8 output, optional MOVM FP8 output.
integration.decision: Keep opt-in: small native dual-output improves about 2.7%, large config 70 near flat, config 106 native dual-output regresses about 1.7%.

address_codegen.alignment: shared tile base aligned to 8 * swizzle_bytes; checked at compile time
address_codegen.c70_quantized: Eight BF16 STSM reuse four addresses with panel immediate 0x2000; four native FP8 STSM reuse the same address registers.
address_codegen.compiler_lifetime: Empty inline asm on factored lane offset limits early hoisting of derived column addresses.

gemm_racecheck.selection: online_equivalence_and_reuse or graph_reuse or next_layer or partial_scale_word or odd_k
